verses.geez: ወኮነ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ዩናስ፡ ወልደ፡ አማቴ፡ ወይቤሎ።
verses.translation: Now the word of the Lord came to Jonas the son of Amathi, saying,

translations.lxx: Now the word of the Lord came to Jonas the son of Amathi, saying,
translations.kjv: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a fost cuvântul Domnului către Iona, fiul lui Amitai, zicând:
translations.grk: ΚΑΙ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ἰωνᾶν τὸν τοῦ Ἀμαθὶ, λέγων,

verses.geez: ተንስእ፡ ወሖር፡ ኀበ፡ ነነዌ፡ ሀገር፡ ዓባይ፡ ወስብክ፡ ሎሙ፡ እስመ፡ ዐርገ፡ ገዓረ፡ እከዩሙ፡ ኀቤየ።
verses.translation: Rise, and go to Nineve, the great city, and preach in it; for the cry of its wickedness is come up to me.

translations.lxx: Rise, and go to Nineve, the great city, and preach in it; for the cry of its wickedness is come up to me.
translations.kjv: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
translations.ron: Scoală-te şi du-te în cetatea cea mare a Ninivei şi propovăduieşte acolo, căci fărădelegile lor au ajuns până în fata Mea!
translations.grk: ἀνάστηθι, καὶ πορεύθητι εἰς Νινευὴ τὴν πόλιν τὴν μεγάλην, καὶ κήρυξον ἐν αὐτῇ, ὅτι ἀνέβη ἡ κραυγὴ τῆς κακίας αὐτῆς πρὸς μέ.

verses.geez: ወሖረ፡ ዩናስ፡ ወተኀጥአ፡ ብሔር፡ ተርሴስ፡ እምገጸ፡ እግዚአብሄር፡ ወወረደ፡ ሀገር፡ ኢዩጴ፡ ወረከበ፡ ሐመረ፡ ዜነግድ፡ ብሔር፡ ተርስስ፡ ዋታዓሳ፡ ሐመረ፡ ርገ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ ይነግድ፡ መስሌሆሙ፡ ተርሴስ፡ እምገጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: But Jonas rose up to flee to Tharsis from the presence of the Lord. And he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tharsis: and he paid his fare, and went up into it, to sail with them to Tharsis from the presence of the Lord.

translations.lxx: But Jonas rose up to flee to Tharsis from the presence of the Lord. And he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tharsis: and he paid his fare, and went up into it, to sail with them to Tharsis from the presence of the Lord.
translations.kjv: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi s-a sculat Iona să fugă la Tarsis, departe de Domnul. Şi s-a coborât la Iope, unde a găsit o corabie, care mergea la Tarsis, şi, plătind preţul călătoriei, s-a coborât în ea ca să meargă la Tarsis împreună cu toţi cei de acolo, el fugind din faţa Domnului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστη Ἰωνᾶς τοῦ φυγεῖν εἰς Θαρσὶς ἐκ προσώπου Κυρίου· καὶ κατέβη εἰς Ἰόππην, καὶ εὗρε πλοῖον βαδίζον εἰς Θαρσὶς, καὶ ἔδωκε τὸ ναῦλον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς αὐτὸ, τοῦ πλεῦσαι μετʼ αὐτῶν εἰς Θαρσὶς ἐκ προσώπου Κυρίου.

verses.geez: ወአምጽአ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ነፋሰ፡ ዓቢየ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ወዐብየ፡ ማዕበለ፡ ባሕር፡ ወተመነደበ፡ ሐመሮሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይሰበር።
verses.translation: And the Lord raised up a wind on the sea; and there was a great storm on the sea, and the ship was in danger of being broken.

translations.lxx: And the Lord raised up a wind on the sea; and there was a great storm on the sea, and the ship was in danger of being broken.
translations.kjv: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
translations.ron: Dar Domnul a ridicat un vânt năpraznic pe mare şi o furtună puternică s-a stârnit, încât corabia era gata să se sfărâme.
translations.grk: Καὶ Κύριος ἐξήγειρε πνεῦμα ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἐγένετο κλύδων μέγας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ, καὶ τὸ πλοῖον ἐκινδύνευε τοῦ συντριβῆναι.

verses.geez: ወፈርሁ፡ ኖትያ፡ ወአውየዉ፡ ኮሎሙ፡ ኀበ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ ወአስተዋፅኡ፡ ወገደፈውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ንሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይቅልል፡ ሐመሮሙ፡ ወወረደ፡ ዮናስ፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሠ፡ ሐመር፡ ወኖመ፡ ወንኀረ።
verses.translation: And the sailors were alarmed, and cried every one to his god, and cast out the wares that were in the ship into the sea, that it might be lightened of them. But Jonas was gone down into the hold of the ship, and was asleep, and snored.

translations.lxx: And the sailors were alarmed, and cried every one to his god, and cast out the wares that were in the ship into the sea, that it might be lightened of them. But Jonas was gone down into the hold of the ship, and was asleep, and snored.
translations.kjv: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
translations.ron: Corăbierii s-au înfricoşat şi au strigat fiecare către dumnezeul său şi au aruncat în mare încărcătura corăbiei ca să se uşureze. Dar Iona se coborâse în fundul corăbiei, se culcase şi adormise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν οἱ ναυτικοὶ, καὶ ἀνεβόησαν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν θεὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκβολὴν ἐποιήσαντο τῶν σκευῶν τῶν ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, τοῦ κουφισθῆναι ἀπʼ αὐτῶν· Ἰωνᾶς δὲ κατέβη εἰς τὴν κοίλην τοῦ πλοίου, καὶ ἐκάθευδε, καὶ ἔρεγχε.

verses.geez: ወወረደ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ዘይሔድፍ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ምንት፡ ያነውመከ፡ ተንስእ፡ ወጸውዕ፡ አምላከ፡ ከመ፡ ያድኀነነ፡ ጦፋዚአብሔር፡ ወኢነሙት።
verses.translation: And the shipmaster came to him, and said to him, Why snorest thou? arise, and call upon thy God, that God may save us, and we perish not.

translations.lxx: And the shipmaster came to him, and said to him, Why snorest thou? arise, and call upon thy God, that God may save us, and we perish not.
translations.kjv: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a apropiat de el cârmaciul corăbiei, şi i-a zis: "Pentru ce dormi? Scoală-te şi strigă către Dumnezeul tău, poate El Îşi va aduce aminte de noi, ca să nu pierim!"
translations.grk: Καὶ προσῆλθε πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ πρωρεὺς, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, τί σὺ ῥέγχεις; ἀνάστα, καὶ ἐπικαλοῦ τὸν Θεόν σου, ὅπως διασώσῃ ὁ Θεὸς ἡμᾶς, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπολώμεθα.

verses.geez: ወተበሃሎ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ንዑ፡ ንትዐፀዉ፡ ወወረደ፡ ፅፃ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዮናስ።
verses.translation: And each man said to his neighbour, Come, let us cast lots, and find out for whose sake this mischief is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonas.

translations.lxx: And each man said to his neighbour, Come, let us cast lots, and find out for whose sake this mischief is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonas.
translations.kjv: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
translations.ron: Şi au zis unul către altul: "Haidem să aruncăm sorţi, ca să ştim din pricina cui a venit peste noi nenorocirea aceasta!" Şi au aruncat sorţi, şi sorţul a căzut pe Iona.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ, δεῦτε βάλωμεν κλήρους, καὶ ἐπιγνῶμεν, τίνος ἕνεκεν ἡ κακία αὕτη ἐστὶν ἐν ἡμῖν· καὶ ἔβαλον κλήρους, καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ κλῆρος ἐπὶ Ἰωνᾶν.

verses.geez: ወይቤልዎ፡ ንግረነ፡ በበይነ፡ ሙኑ፡ ረከበተነ፡ ዛቲ፡ እኪት፡ ወምንት፡ ተግባርከ፡ ወእምአይቴ፡ መጻእከ፡ ወአይቴ፡ ተሐውር፡ ወአይቴ፡ ብሔርክ፡ ወምንት፡ ሕዝብከ።
verses.translation: And they said to him, Tell us what is thine occupation, and whence comest thou, and of what country and what people art thou?

translations.lxx: And they said to him, Tell us what is thine occupation, and whence comest thou, and of what country and what people art thou?
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
translations.ron: Şi l-au întrebat pe el: "Spune-ne nouă din pricina cui s-a abătut nenorocirea aceasta asupra noastră? Care este meşteşugul tău, de unde şi din ce ţară vii şi din ce popor eşti?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτὸν, ἀπάγγειλον ἡμῖν, τίς σου ἡ ἐργασία ἐστὶ, καὶ πόθεν ἔρχῃ, καὶ ἐκ ποίας χώρας, καὶ ἐκ ποίου λαοῦ εἶ σύ;

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ፡ ገብረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላከ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዝገብረ፡ ባሕረ፡ ወየብስ።
verses.translation: And he said to them, I am a servant of the Lord; and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea, and the dry land.

translations.lxx: And he said to them, I am a servant of the Lord; and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea, and the dry land.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.
translations.ron: Atunci el le-a răspuns: "Sunt evreu şi Domnului Dumnezeului cerului mă închin - Cel care a făcut marea şi uscatul".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε πρὸς αὐτοὺς, δοῦλος Κυρίου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ, καὶ τὸν Κύριον Θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐγὼ σέβομαι, ὃς ἐποίησε τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ τὴν ξηράν.

verses.geez: ወፈርሁ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዕደው፡ ዓቢየ፡ ፍርሃተ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ ምን፡ ገበርክ፡ ወአእመርዎ፡ እንቱ፡ ዕደው፡ ከመ፡ እምገጸ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ተኀጥአ፡ እስመ፡ ነገሮሙ።
verses.translation: Then the men feared exceedingly, and said to him, What is this that thou hast done? for the men knew that he was fleeing from the face of the Lord, because he had told them.

translations.lxx: Then the men feared exceedingly, and said to him, What is this that thou hast done? for the men knew that he was fleeing from the face of the Lord, because he had told them.
translations.kjv: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
translations.ron: Şi toţi oamenii s-au temut cu frică mare şi i-au zis lui: "Pentru ce ai săvârşit una ca aceasta?" Căci ei ştiau că el fuge din faţa lui Dumnezeu, fiindcă el le spusese.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν οἱ ἄνδρες φόβον μέγαν, καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτὸν, τί τοῦτο ἐποίησας; διότι ἔγνωσαν οἱ ἄνδρες ὅτι ἐκ προσώπου Κυρίου ἦν φεύγων, ὅτι ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς·

verses.geez: ወይቤልዎ፡ ምነተ፡ እንከ፡ ንረሲከ፡ ወይኀድገነ፡ ባሕር፡ ስመ፡ ይትሀወክ፡ ባሕር፡ ወይትነሣእ፡ መዕበል፡ ዓቢይ።
verses.translation: And they said to him, What shall we do to thee, that the sea may be calm to us? for the sea rose, and lifted its wave exceedingly.

translations.lxx: And they said to him, What shall we do to thee, that the sea may be calm to us? for the sea rose, and lifted its wave exceedingly.
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
translations.ron: Şi i-au zis lui: "Ce să-ţi facem ca să se potolească marea?" Căci marea se ridica din ce în ce mai mult.
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτὸν, τί ποιήσομέν σοι, καὶ κοπάσει ἡ θάλασσα ἀφʼ ἡμῶν; ὅτι ἡ θάλασσα ἐπορεύετο καὶ ἐξήγειρε μᾶλλον κλύδωνα.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ፡ ዮናስ፡ ንሥኡኒ፡ ወውርዉኒ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ወየኀድገክሙ፡ ባሕ፡ እነ፡ አአምር፡ ከመ፡ በእንቲአየ፡ መጽአክሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ማዕበል፡ ዐቢይ።
verses.translation: And Jonas said to them, Take me up, and cast me into the sea, and the sea shall be calm to you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

translations.lxx: And Jonas said to them, Take me up, and cast me into the sea, and the sea shall be calm to you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
translations.ron: Atunci el a răspuns: "Luaţi-mă şi mă aruncaţi în mare şi ea se va potoli, căci ştiu bine că din pricina mea s-a pornit peste voi această vijelie".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰωνᾶς πρὸς αὐτοὺς, ἄρατέ με, καὶ ἐμβάλετέ με εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ κοπάσει ἡ θάλασσα ἀφʼ ὑμῶν· διότι ἔγνωκα ἐγὼ, ὅτι διʼ ἐμὲ ὁ κλύδων ὁ μέγας οὗτος ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς ἐστι.

verses.geez: ወተባአሱ፡ ይትመየጡ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዕደው፡ ወስእኑ፡ እስመ፡ ትትሀወክ፡ ባሕር፡ ወትትነሣእ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: And the men tried hard to return to the land, and were not able: for the sea rose and grew more and more tempestuous against them.

translations.lxx: And the men tried hard to return to the land, and were not able: for the sea rose and grew more and more tempestuous against them.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
translations.ron: Şi marinarii vâsleau ca să ajungă la ţărm, dar în zadar, căci marea se ridica din ce în ce mai mult împotriva lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρεβιάζοντο οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι πρὸς τὴν γῆν, καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο, ὅτι ἡ θάλασσα ἐπορεύετο, καὶ ἐξηγείρετο μᾶλλον ἐπʼ αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወአውየዉ፡ ኰሎሙ፡ ኀቡረ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይቤሉ፡ ሐሰ፡ ለከ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ኢታጥፍአነ፡ በበይነ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኢትረሲ፡ ላዕሌነ፡ ከመ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እስመ፡ አንተ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ዘከመ፡ ፈቀድከ፡ ገበርከ።
verses.translation: And they cried to the Lord, and said, Forbid it, Lord: let us not perish for the sake of this man's life, and bring not righteous blood upon us: for thou, Lord, hast done as thou wouldest.

translations.lxx: And they cried to the Lord, and said, Forbid it, Lord: let us not perish for the sake of this man's life, and bring not righteous blood upon us: for thou, Lord, hast done as thou wouldest.
translations.kjv: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD, and said, We beseech thee, O LORD, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD, hast done as it pleased thee.
translations.ron: Atunci au strigat către Domnul şi au zis: "O, Doamne, de-am putea să nu pierim din pricina vieţii acestui om şi să nu ne împovărezi pe noi cu un sânge nevinovat! Că Tu, Doamne, precum ai voit ai făcut!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνεβόησαν πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ εἶπαν, μηδαμῶς Κύριε· μὴ ἀπολώμεθα ἕνεκεν τῆς ψυχῆς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου, καὶ μὴ δῷς ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς αἷμα δίκαιον, διότι σὺ Κύριε, ὃν τρόπον ἐβούλου, πεποίηκας.

verses.geez: ወነስእዎ፡ ሌነስ፡ ወወረውዎ፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕረ፡ ወአርመመት፡ ባሕር።
verses.translation: So they took Jonas, and cast him out into the sea: and the sea ceased from its raging.

translations.lxx: So they took Jonas, and cast him out into the sea: and the sea ceased from its raging.
translations.kjv: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
translations.ron: Şi îl ridicară pe Iona şi îl aruncară în mare şi s-a potolit urgia ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβον τὸν Ἰωνᾶν, καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν, καὶ ἔστη ἡ θάλασσα ἐκ τοῦ σάλου αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወፈርህዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እሙንቱ፡ ዕደው፡ ዓቢየ፡ ፍርሃተ፡ ወሦዑ፡ እግዝአብሔር፡ መስዋዕተ፡ ወበፅዑ፡ ብፅዓተ።
verses.translation: And the men feared the Lord very greatly, and offered a sacrifice to the Lord, and vowed vows.

translations.lxx: And the men feared the Lord very greatly, and offered a sacrifice to the Lord, and vowed vows.
translations.kjv: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD, and made vows.
translations.ron: Şi oamenii s-au temut cu teamă mare de Domnul şi au adus jertfă lui Dumnezeu şi I-au făcut Lui făgăduinţe.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν οἱ ἄνδρες φόβῳ μεγάλῳ τὸν Κύριον, καὶ ἔθυσαν θυσίαν τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ ηὔξαντο τὰς εὐχάς.

note: God sends Jonah to Nineveh. He flees. The book's message — that God's mercy extends beyond Israel — resonates with the Ethiopian tradition's claim that God chose Ethiopia as covenant partner alongside (and then instead of) Israel.
